text_block_list.text:
One day, when I visited a greengrocer in 
the shopping district to buy ingredients……

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, dried persimmons are so cheeeep! 
We're getting such great bargains today.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Feel free to buy some on 
your way out, we've stocked all sorts of 
fresh fruits today.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, of course! I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ so glossy-apple...! I kinda wanna 
take a huge bite out of it whole!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Besides, those strawberries over there 
look bright red and delicious too! Mmm, I 
just can't decide~.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I've decided!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: I'll take this, pleaaase!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Ehehe, I can't wait to eat it~♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks! I went through the trouble 
of stocking it, but it didn't really sell. 
You're the first one to ever buy it!
choice_data_list:
Maybe they were looking for a coconut in 
the first place?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: No, it's not like that! ...It's just—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
This fruit feels like the biggest one of 
all!
choice_data_list:
Aren't there even bigger fruits around, 
though...?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Those watermelons and cantaloupes 
were super big, too! I had trouble picking 
which one to get, but—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Still, coconuts are really hard to eat!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the biggest part of all, at 
least according to Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
All right, first I gotta get tools ready 
to crack open the hard shell! And then I 
need to figure out how to eat it, right?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm getting so excited! The moment 
I get back, I'm taking on the challenge~!
choice_data_list:
Taking on challenges is what truly matters 
to you, isn't it?

Taking on challenges is what truly matters 
to you, isn't it?
I kinda want to know more about Big...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm getting so excited! The moment 
I get back, I'm taking on the challenge~!
choice_data_list:
Taking on challenges is what truly matters 
to you, isn't it?

Taking on challenges is what truly matters 
to you, isn't it?
I kinda want to know more about Big...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Taste is important, of course, but 
taking on a big challenge is what truly 
makes it big!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I definitely have to choose the 
challenging path! All so I can become the 
biggest Umamusume in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you interested in Big? Hehe, 
with pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
For instance, let's see... How about that 
pineapple over there!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
With that pineapple, we could probably do 
one of those fancy, difficult cuts! Now 
that's big!
